contracts.name: LinkService
contracts.summary:
The frozen RPC boundary for saving, tagging, and listing links. Draws the line between
the web client and the backend for the core capture flow: SaveLink, ListLinks, AddTag,
RemoveTag, ListByTag. Frozen at contract freeze so the web app and api can be built in
parallel against a stable shape; every call is scoped to the authenticated user (INV-0001).

contracts.name: CollectionService
contracts.summary:
The RPC boundary for collections and sharing: CreateCollection, AddMember, Publish,
Revoke, and an unauthenticated GetSharedCollection that resolves a share token. Still
draft while the revocation and token-rotation semantics are being negotiated; not yet
safe to build the public share view against.
